versions.changelog: Composio para buscar (Tavily y Apify) con comandos exactos en f100k-puente, actores con virgulilla y reglas de evidencia

Initial release — skill for cloning and enhancing any Instagram/TikTok carousel with your content and brand.

- Receives a carousel reference via screenshot(s) or direct Instagram/TikTok link; auto-downloads slides when possible.
- Extracts the visual "DNA" (layout, font, palette, hook pattern, slide structure) from the reference, then applies F100K principles for improved virality and legibility.
- Renders a full, ready-to-upload carousel in PNG (HTML + Chromium headless; 1080×1350px by default), using your topic and brand assets.
- Delivers PNG files via Telegram, preserving style but correcting design weaknesses.
- Only activates with a visual reference; guides user on requirements and process.
